relationship_to_frozen_roster.frozen_roster_consumption: All six original roster rows have been consumed or dispositioned; this register does not amend, replace, reorder, revive, or relabel an original roster row.

company.name: 贵州茅台酒股份有限公司

eligible_only_if: the original six-row roster is exhausted without changing its frozen order
the company represents a business-model and lifecycle class not used for selection of the prior six Blind cases
official issuer annual reports for FY2021, FY2022, and FY2023 were disclosed on or before the cutoff and can form a cutoff-before source packet
permitted_selection_inputs: exhaustion of the original six-row frozen roster
company identity, sector classification, business-model class, and lifecycle class only
official-document identity, disclosure date, title page, and table of contents for FY2021, FY2022, and FY2023
selection_rule.reason_not_result_selected: CN:600519 is selected solely to add a mature premium branded-spirit producer with a customer-channel and cash-cycle research surface heterogeneous to prior industrial and service selections. Its three official cutoff-before annual reports are available. No FY2024 result source, price/return, analyst material, or candidate-result comparison was accessed.
prohibited_selection_inputs: FY2024 annual-report content or any other post-cutoff company result
FY2024 document metadata, URL, source inventory, or disclosure-date search
price, return, market performance, analyst commentary, valuation, or derived company report
prior-case result direction, expected utility, or outcome quality
selection of another company because this case is expected to be easier, better, or worse

preoutcome_research_problem.materiality_statement: The next forecaster must decide whether the operating chain is material from cutoff-before issuer evidence. This registration makes no factual or directional company judgment.
preoutcome_research_problem.state_and_constraint: For a mature premium branded-spirit producer, separate brand-controlled supply and channel architecture from demonstrated end-customer absorption and channel-stock conditions.
preoutcome_research_problem.management_choice_or_no_action: Assess shipment cadence, product and price architecture, customer-channel allocation, and distribution controls without presuming an outcome.
preoutcome_research_problem.customer_or_operating_link: Trace the choice through customer purchase/depletion, distributor/channel inventory and collection quality, delivery mix, and operating execution before recognizing economic credit.
preoutcome_research_problem.cash_or_capital_link: Separate sales and reported profit from cash receipts, contract liabilities, inventory, working-capital movement, and capital spending before treating any result as owner cash or capital return.

selection_agent_read_boundary: the frozen roster and selector receipt
the CN600309 selection and forecaster-execution templates
only the title and table-of-contents pages of CN600519 official FY2021, FY2022, and FY2023 annual reports
role_and_source_firewall.preoutcome_source_allowed_for_next_forec: Only the three files and source receipt named in 85_CN600519_CUTOFF_BEFORE_SOURCE_PACKET_RECEIPT.json, plus the worktree AGENTS.md instructions required for the isolated role.
role_and_source_firewall.outcome_source_sealed: The issuer official FY2024 annual report has not been opened, searched, inventoried, or linked. It remains sealed until a fresh forecaster freezes a judgment contract and a result-free independent preoutcome review accepts it.

activation_prerequisites: fresh forecaster's preoutcome judgment is frozen
independent result-free preoutcome review accepts the judgment contract
a separate one-case outcome-access authorization names the exact official FY2024 document
may_read: the accepted preoutcome judgment contract solely to identify frozen settlement cells
the one authorized issuer official FY2024 annual report solely to settle those matching operating or cash/capital cells
must_not_read_or_do: selection material, prior-case outcomes, method packs, curricula, prices, returns, valuation, or investment recommendations
expand settlement beyond a contracted cell
convert an unavailable or mismatched measure into a different measure
write an enterprise synthesis, a training-effectiveness conclusion, or an investment conclusion
custodian_authority_frozen.mismatch_treatment: A non-matching, non-disclosed, or perimeter-incompatible measure receives LOCAL_UNKNOWN or MEASUREMENT_MISMATCH for that cell only; it does not invalidate remaining contracted cells or create a new global gate.
